# tools: add fq

Add [fq](https://github.com/wader/fq), "jq for binary formats" — a tool that decodes binary files (media containers, archives, executables, network captures) into a structured tree and queries it with `jq` syntax — as a companion to the text-oriented `jq`/`gojq` for inspecting the audio/video files the author processes with `ffmpeg` and Whisper.
